bullets.text: Garbage spilling from a vacant plot on 14th street in Ambattur industrial estate blocked access to three factories, and the office should monitor cleanup efforts.
Deloitte opened its 27th Indian office in Mangaluru as part of the Beyond Bengaluru push, and the office should watch this regional IT expansion trend.

stories.title: Garbage spillover blocks access to factories in Ambattur industrial estate
takeaways: Waste accumulation from a vacant plot blocked access to three factories in Ambattur SIDCO.
Local industrialists face operational disruption due to poor municipal waste management.
